purpose: Prospectively audit every V8 N192 projection against the sealed reference-only CF4 and released-mode calibration without selecting a seed or opening any P1/P2 subset.

calibration_policy.threshold_source: Use every L0-L5 threshold, transform, quantile, bootstrap scale, and critical value exactly as stored in the hash-pinned reference program and calibration.
calibration_policy.L0_failure_action: Write an L0 fail result and stop before constructing the CF4 forward operator or calculating any V8 CF4/released-mode metric.
calibration_policy.permutation_labels: One common 255/256 split of each pooled 511-row vector for all nine L3 coordinates.
calibration_policy.simultaneous_envelope: Use the sealed joint L4/L5 99% bootstrap critical value and coordinate scales without recalibration.

metric_implementation.L0_projection: For every seed, call the hash-pinned cf4_make_ic.fourier_resample_white_field on the N576 s_conditioned array and compare the resulting float32 N192 spatial field with the stored s_out. Divide RMS and maximum absolute error by RMS(recomputed N192).
metric_implementation.L1_frozen_modes: Apply the exact complement of free_rfft_mask(192,64) to norm='ortho' rFFT coefficients of each N192 proposal and parent3429. Divide coefficient RMS and coefficient maximum absolute difference by the RMS of parent3429 coefficients on that exact F64 mask.
metric_implementation.L3: Use marginal deviance per CF4 row for the six permutation coordinates; raw-deviance and per-row forms are equivalent under the positive common CF4 row count for all order and shift gates. Extra median/Q90 thresholds are reported in raw-deviance units.
metric_implementation.L4_L5: Apply the transforms, coordinate Q99 values, bootstrap scales, and single joint simultaneous critical value stored in the sealed reference calibration.

storage.write_policy: exclusive create; an existing path is immutable and may not be overwritten

decision.on_any_L0_to_L5_failure: Current N64-freeze architecture is V9 NO-GO; do not select a seed, extend the bank, or run RAMSES.
decision.on_all_L0_to_L5_pass: Authorize design of a new prospective V9 only; do not promote a V8 seed or run RAMSES.
